summary.vi: Thì quá khứ hoàn thành tiếp diễn dùng had been + V-ing để nói một hành động đã đang kéo dài trước một mốc hoặc sự việc khác trong quá khứ.
summary.en: The past perfect continuous uses had been + V-ing to describe an activity that was ongoing before another past point or event.

sub.vi: hành động kéo dài trước quá khứ

when_to_use.vi: Khi bạn muốn nhấn mạnh thời lượng của một hành động tính đến một mốc trong quá khứ, thường với for hoặc since.
when_to_use.en: When you want to emphasise how long an activity had continued up to a past point, often with for or since.

when_to_use.vi: Khi một hành động đang tiếp diễn thì một sự việc khác trong quá khứ xen vào hoặc xảy ra sau đó.
when_to_use.en: When an activity was in progress and another past event interrupted it or happened later.

when_to_use.vi: Khi bạn giải thích nguyên nhân hoặc kết quả trong quá khứ bằng một quá trình xảy ra trước đó.
when_to_use.en: When you explain a past result or situation by referring to an earlier ongoing process.

label.vi: trợ động từ đảo lên đầu

examples.text: She had been studying for hours before the exam started.

annotation.vi: hành động học đã kéo dài nhiều giờ trước khi kỳ thi bắt đầu
annotation.en: the studying continued for hours before the exam began

translation.vi: Cô ấy đã học nhiều giờ trước khi kỳ thi bắt đầu.
translation.en: She had been studying for hours before the exam started.

examples.text: The road was wet because it had been raining.

annotation.vi: mưa là quá trình xảy ra trước, giải thích vì sao đường ướt
annotation.en: the rain was an earlier ongoing process that explains the wet road

translation.vi: Đường ướt vì trước đó trời đã mưa.
translation.en: The road was wet because it had been raining.

examples.text: They hadn't been waiting long when the bus arrived.

annotation.vi: hành động chờ đã không kéo dài lâu tính đến lúc xe buýt đến
annotation.en: the waiting had not continued long up to the moment the bus came

translation.vi: Họ đã không chờ lâu khi xe buýt đến.
translation.en: They hadn't been waiting long when the bus arrived.

reason.vi: know là động từ trạng thái, không dùng ở dạng tiếp diễn; phải dùng quá khứ hoàn thành đơn.
reason.en: know is a stative verb and is not used in the continuous form; the past perfect simple is required.

common_mistakes.wrong: She had been knowing him for years.
common_mistakes.right: She had known him for years.

quick_practice.q: He was tired because he ___ all night.

explain.vi: Hành động làm việc kéo dài suốt đêm trước khi anh ấy mệt, nên dùng had been working.
explain.en: The working continued all night before he was tired, so had been working is correct.

quick_practice.q: They ___ for the train for twenty minutes when it was cancelled.

explain.vi: Nhấn mạnh thời lượng chờ đợi trước khi chuyến tàu bị hủy, nên dùng had been waiting.
explain.en: The duration of waiting before the cancellation is emphasised, so had been waiting is correct.

quick_practice.q: ___ she been studying English before she moved to London?

explain.vi: Câu hỏi của quá khứ hoàn thành tiếp diễn bắt đầu bằng Had, không dùng Has hay Did.
explain.en: Past perfect continuous questions begin with Had, not Has or Did.

prompt.vi: Viết một câu về việc bạn đã làm gì trong một khoảng thời gian trước một sự việc trong quá khứ.
prompt.en: Write a sentence about what you had been doing for a period before a past event.

sample.text: I had been working there for two years before I changed jobs.

corrections.issue: R5 example 'They had been waiting since noon.' lacks a clear past reference point, so the past perfect continuous is not fully justified.
corrections.fix: Replaced with 'They hadn't been waiting long when the bus arrived.' to include a past reference and a negative form.

corrections.issue: R5 mistake 'I had been working yesterday.' is not a typical Vietnamese learner error for this point and the correction 'I was working yesterday.' changes the intended meaning rather than fixing a form error.
corrections.fix: Replaced with the stative-verb error 'She had been knowing him for years.' corrected to 'She had known him for years.'

corrections.issue: R5 did not provide a structured formula, negative, question, or quick practice items.
corrections.fix: Added formula, negative, question, and three quick practice questions with tagged distractors.
